grounded.evidence_quote: Following activation of p53, for example by viral infection or induction of DNA damage, p21 expression is upregulated.
p53 levels are induced by cellular stress, for example following DNA damage or viral infection.
We have employed HCT116 wild-type and knockout cells that were treated with the MDM2 antagonist nutlin-3a and the DNA-damaging agent doxorubicin to increase p53 levels.
